Young Oakley practiced and practiced. She trained in the ranch from dawn to dusk. At times, her father felt surreptitiously surprised by and proud of little Oakley's talents, while other times he fretted over her future living the life of a musketeer.

Oakley's mother seemed to be the only one who actually cared and felt for young Oakley's tender little hands, often blaming Oakley's father for teaching her how to fire a gun.

From the time of that fateful duel to the time when she scored her first ever bounty earning much of her later fame, Oakley had used the same pair of worn gloves for years. Her peers didn't understand her insistence on wearing the same pair of broken gloves — Only she knew the conflicting emotions within those gloves, for they were the parting gifts her mother gave her.

What sort of emotional struggles must Oakley's mother have gone through, when she had been so stubbornly opposed to Oakley learning her way around guns?

After that duel, her mother wept unceasingly in Oakley's arms. Oakley didn't say anything, but her mother had already read Oakley's thoughts.

To our most cherished friends across the cosmos, the people of Astropolis:

Good morning.

Today, we welcome the dawn of a new Amber Era, the <unbreak>2158</unbreak>th Amber Era. As we reflect on the era behind us, we have many achievements for which we owe gratitude to the Amber Lord. Most of us have received more education than our parents and grandparents, enjoy longer lives, and have access to a wider array of planets to call home. Some claim that a new era heralds new perils. I beg to differ. In this cosmos, there is nothing but new hope, and old perils clad in new guises. Eternal perils.

Let us not forget: the Amber Lord does not rid us of danger. THEIR blessing lies in protecting us from it. We dedicate all to the Amber Lord, yet we preserve in our hearts the aspirations for the future. The Interastral Peace Entertainment we have cultivated with every fiber of our being is the manifestation of that aspiration. Do not deem yourselves obsolete. Do not relegate certain sentiments to the past. New forms of expression and new hopes are our very weapons against enduring perils. For new hope to flourish, we need more and finer works of creation, conveying ever purer emotions. Only when hearts are truly interwoven will the Amber Lord's grace not be squandered.

Our incentives remain steadfast. Cloudpeak opens its doors to all who harbor dreams. Interastral Peace Entertainment preserves the very soul of the IPC, a noble calling that deserves the full commitment of every one of us.
